body:
## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: Design, Test and revised System, plus the two scoped published-skill-first specification/test-specification amendments; exact identities appear in this record's subjects. Relevant interactions are source ownership, retirement, validation applicability, operational consumers and follow-up boundaries.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r2.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r2, round 2.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through primary review record.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: route for authorized Delivery planning; this reviewer makes no activity change.
- Claim limitations: exact Design-package approval for planning only. No completed removal, implementation correctness, test retirement, new model adoption, final Verify, branch/PR readiness, publication or customer installation is established.

## Independence and exact scope

The parent necessary-design-author authored the five package contributions, the System candidate map and the candidate-spec-disposition-audit. This separately delegated reviewer authored none of those contributions and edited no engineering or routing surface. I read the complete five members and their embedded examples, the merged approved proposal and Proposal Review r2, prior Design Review r1, selected source material and the current audit. Recording mode is formal-lifecycle. This is a fresh package assessment, not renewal of the old review by changing its subject identity. R1 remains stale and byte-preserved.

The approved direction requires necessary meaning, precise current owners, actual justified source cleanup and proportionate validation. The user's later request permits provisional candidate boundaries in System and association of old sources; it does not require every candidate model to be built or removal of a necessary source merely because no model file exists. The candidate map explicitly preserves this distinction. Candidate-family audit evidence is assessed as bounded retention analysis, not independent implementation proof or approval of every historical clause.

## Assessment

| Criterion | Judgment | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Behavior and realization | pass | DES-SR-21 defines actual remaining-use and complete-meaning conditions. TEST-SR-14 provides precise scoped obligations and exceptions. System names the exact source sections and interactions. Existing models and ordinary source edits can realize this without a new subsystem. |
| Constraints and failure boundaries | pass | Runtime write/recovery checks, external permissions, supported package guarantees and independent final review/Verify remain intact. Unknown meaning, actual readers and incomplete transfer stop the affected removal. No absent-model inference may retire supported behavior. |
| Approved goals and feasibility | pass | The package selects actual deletion of the validation ADR and diagram and three redundant architecture subsections. Mixed operational specifications remain for stated reasons. Provisional candidates and audit do not turn the cleanup into inventory-only work or require new models. |
| Ownership and composition | pass | Design owns preservation/disposition; Test owns the scoped protective criteria; System references their composition. Existing Skill, Review and Closeout, Workflow, Record Format and CLI responsibilities remain separate. Distribution produces identities, Installation verifies them for writes and Release records published identities; those are distinct interface obligations. |
| Decisions and history | pass | Necessary original validation decisions and meaningful alternatives survive in SYS-DEC-04, current owners and the retained operational spec. Exact old judgments are neither rewritten nor made approval of replacement content. Earlier separately scoped archive commitments remain unchanged. Incidental citation is distinguished from operational or assessment reliance. |
| Consumer reconciliation | pass | Current ADR/diagram navigation, mixed-spec amendments and FU-012 are explicit consumers. The historical ledger remains an operational fixture. Canonical/package inputs and current candidate metadata require inspected unaffected dispositions or bounded corrections with dependent proof. No consumer is excused solely by filename or source age. |
| Acceptance and evidence | pass | Complete transfer, mixed retention, historical citation, hidden operational reader and changed package identity yield distinguishable outcomes. Delivery can allocate focused structural/reference and semantic proof. RC-SR-15 governs actual reuse; new review does not require unrelated runtime suites, but changed dependencies or freshness requirements require adequate new proof. |
| Migration precision and remainder | pass | Exact whole-source and heading boundaries distinguish selected deletions from retained architecture, operational clauses and other candidates. FU-012 receives residual execution work, FU-013 the Distribution/Installation/Release decisions and FU-014 unclassified responsibilities. No blanket spec deletion or implicit model programme is selected. |

## Retained meaning and scoped amendment classification

Test's retained-contract table supplies actual requirements, their applicable population and selected changes for R14/R17–20/R22. It preserves protected failures, deterministic appropriateness, simpler-owner consideration, invocation and repair, accepted/rejected-case inspection, unknown-protection investigation, surviving detection, owner-approved retirement and recoverable correction. It removes a second ledger and irrelevant compulsory repetition/measurement only for the selected cleanup. Missing old proof cannot become a fabricated equivalence; explicit obligation retirement does not require reproducing deliberately retired behavior. Useful unchanged suites remain intact without compulsory retroactive annotation.

The two legacy notices are new-profile-only amendments. They preserve the historical BND/INT/PRF/E/T identities, illustrations and original input table, while clearly scoping the selected exception. Their old procedure and Readiness/Next artifacts prose belongs to their original population and planning history, not current routing. No new test specification or retired validator procedure is required. The complete files remain necessary for operational proof intent that this package does not transfer.

The complete validation ADR and diagram and the three selected architecture subsections were compared with destinations. Canonical integrity, all-target package equivalence, declared transformations, composed release proof, separate semantic and record assessment, narrowly justified filesystem materialization, bounded retirement and conservative unknown behavior survive. The old diagram's YAML/Markdown lifecycle label does not revive a retired runtime format. Original ADR approval is not relied on to establish this replacement package's correctness.

## Revised System and candidate audit

The four candidates are potential responsibility boundaries, not approved new files or adopted owners. Their rationale explains why a distinct owner might be useful without deriving model count from source count. The source-family table maps real legacy files and architecture areas and names receiving decisions. The no-model disposition table covers existing-owner transfer, necessary distinct responsibility, no remaining use and unresolved meaning. These choices preserve the user's intended removal of obsolete representation without deleting unmigrated engineering obligations.

I inspected the audit's eleven-spec disposition rationale and checked representative cited clauses and supersession boundaries in its sources. The bounded result is supported: necessary unmigrated obligations prevent whole-file deletion now. Alias inventory rules are distinct from Skill content; target-native command and managed-state rules amend older installation assumptions while preserving hashing/trust; release profiles and permissions remain separately owned; selection/preflight/cache rules are not fully replaced by Test criteria or semantic evidence reuse. The four partially retained candidates are proposals for later clause reconciliation, not permission to trim them in this cleanup. The cache audit explicitly leaves actual reachability and retirement to FU-012; it does not infer operational necessity merely from a test fixture filename. Matching test specifications and the entire repository were not audited for deletion, and no such claim is approved.

FU-012's current text still contains prospective Skill adoption and a selected Validation Execution owner. System explicitly allocates its correction at adoption. This planned consumer correction must actually occur before closeout; its current discrepancy is not evidence of a completed transfer. The other follow-ups remain separate. This review does not repeat or renew the completed Skill pilot's final Verify.

## Checks, applicability and limits

Ran `python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/design/test/test.md --path docs/design/system/system.md --path specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md --path specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.test.md`: passed, structure/references only. Ran `git diff --check`: passed. No runtime/package/release execution is claimed or needed to decide this Design-only scope. Author evidence's unchanged legacy prose-header failures remain disclosed; they are not relabelled passing whole-file prose validation.

Current primary context contains no findings or blockers; the prior r1 was clean and stale because System changed. Fresh subject inspection covers all five members and relied-on authority/source/evidence reads. Approval follows the adequately assessed/no-required-correction condition of RC-SR-03. Applicability is limited to the exact current package and bounded consolidation. The inspection does not claim a complete implementation dependency graph; Delivery must complete the named actual-reader and candidate-metadata dispositions before removal. Historical review bytes, model files, spec files and activity remain unchanged by this review.
independence_basis: Separately delegated reviewer authored none of the five engineering contributions, candidate map or audit, read complete package and relevant basis, and changed only own review evidence.
